sources.entry: Claude Code Security Review by Anthropic - An official AI-powered security-review GitHub Action that uses Claude to analyze pull-request diffs for vulnerabilities.

summary.one_liner: An official GitHub Action from Anthropic that uses Claude to review pull-request diffs for security vulnerabilities and post findings as PR comments.
summary.what_it_does: The action runs Claude (via Claude Code) against the changed files in a pull request to look for security issues, going beyond pattern matching to reason about code semantics. Findings are generated with explanations, severity ratings, and remediation guidance, then filtered by a false-positive pass that drops categories such as denial of service, rate limiting, resource exhaustion, generic input validation, and open redirects. Results can be posted as review comments on specific lines and uploaded as artifacts, and the action exposes a findings-count and results-file output. Scanning can be scoped with excluded directories, a chosen Claude model, a timeout, and custom instruction files for scanning and false-positive filtering. The same analysis is also available as a /security-review command inside Claude Code, which can be customized by copying its markdown file into a project.
use_cases: automated security review of pull requests
catching vulnerabilities before merge in CI
adding AI code review to GitHub workflows
reviewing pending changes in Claude Code with /security-review
scanning for hardcoded secrets and injection flaws in diffs
customizing security review rules for an organization
how_to_run: Add a workflow file at .github/workflows/security.yml with pull-requests: write and contents: read permissions
Trigger the workflow on pull_request and check out the PR head sha with fetch-depth: 2
Store your Anthropic API key in the repository secret CLAUDE_API_KEY and pass it as claude-api-key
For the Claude Code command, copy security-review.md into your project's .claude/commands/ folder
Run tests locally with pytest claudecode -v after cd into the repository
notable: Diff-aware: on pull requests it only analyzes changed files
Two-stage pipeline with a separate false-positive filtering step
Customizable audit prompt and false-positive rules via instruction text files
Same analysis available as a Claude Code /security-review slash command
Evaluation framework for testing against arbitrary PRs
caveats: Not hardened against prompt injection; README advises using it only on trusted PRs and requiring approval for external contributors
API key must be enabled for both the Claude API and Claude Code usage
Run-every-commit mode may increase false positives on PRs with many commits
keywords: find security bugs in code changes
